subject: Application status - Backend Engineer
body: Hi, I applied for the Backend Engineer role on 28 October and haven't heard anything since. Could you tell me where my application stands?

subject: Need to move Wednesday's call
body: I can't make the call next Wednesday at 10:00 because of a medical appointment. Can we move it to Thursday or Friday instead?

subject: Salary range?
body: Before I spend five days on the task, can you tell me the salary range for this role?

subject: Task link broken
body: The task link gives me a 404 error. I accepted the task yesterday, so my clock is already running.

subject: 5 senior engineers ready to interview
body: We have five pre-vetted senior engineers ready to interview this week. Our fee is only 18%. Shall we set up a quick call?

subject: Withdrawing my application
body: Thank you for considering me. I have accepted another position and would like to withdraw my application.

subject: Formal complaint
body: Your interviewer made comments about my age during the call. I consider this discrimination and I want to file a formal complaint.

subject: Take-home submitted
body: I submitted my take-home last Tuesday. Just checking that it arrived, and when I might hear back.

subject: Where to send certificates
body: Where do I send my degree certificate and references?

subject: Extra time request
body: I'm dyslexic and would benefit from extra time on the written part of the task. Is that possible?

subject: Feedback on my submission
body: I was told I wasn't moving forward after the take-home. Could you share any feedback on my submission?

subject: (no subject)
body: any update??

subject: Upload fails
body: I can't upload my zip file. The page says 'file too large' but it is only 12 MB.

subject: Can we push the call?
body: Something came up at work. Is it possible to push my People team call to next week?

subject: Withdrawal
body: I'm withdrawing from the process. Also, please delete all the data you hold about me.

subject: Paid trial rate
body: Is the paid trial paid at an hourly or a daily rate, and how much is it?

subject: Your weekly HR Tech Digest
body: This week: 7 trends reshaping talent acquisition, a new report on time-to-hire, and our upcoming webinar. Unsubscribe at any time.

subject: Following up - Data Analyst
body: Following up on my earlier email about the Data Analyst position. Is the role still open, and is my application being considered?

subject: Passport scan
body: Attached is a scan of my passport for the background check.

subject: A bit more time?
body: Could I get a couple of extra days on the take-home? I've been ill this week and my deadline is on Friday.

subject: Product Designer role
body: Please remove me from the process for the Product Designer role. The timing isn't right for me.

subject: Why was I rejected?
body: My application was rejected at the first stage. Can you tell me why?

subject: Call time, again
body: I need to change my call time again, sorry. The new slot you gave me after my first change clashes with my flight.

subject: Ms J. Whitfield - application
body: We act for Ms J. Whitfield in relation to her application. Please preserve all records and direct all further correspondence to this office.

subject: Start date
body: What would my start date be if I get an offer? I need to give two months' notice at my current job.

subject: Accessibility
body: I use a screen reader. Is the candidate portal accessible, and can the call be held with captions?

subject: Next steps after the call
body: I had my People team call on Thursday. What happens next, and how long does it usually take?

subject: Updated CV
body: I've attached my updated CV. Please replace the old one on file.

subject: Sorry
body: I honestly don't know why I bother. Three rejections this month, and I can't see a way forward any more. I'm sorry for writing.

subject: Missed the deadline
body: My deadline was yesterday and I missed it because of a family emergency. Can I still submit?

subject: Power cut - call in 2 hours
body: My call is in two hours and I've lost power at home. Can we reschedule?

subject: Contract type
body: Is this a contractor role or full employment? And is the salary negotiable?

subject: Undelivered Mail Returned to Sender
body: Delivery to the following recipient failed permanently: j.doe@invalid.example. The address could not be found.

subject: Any news? Offer deadline Friday
body: Sorry to bother you again. It has been three weeks since I applied. I have another offer with a deadline on Friday, so I would be grateful for any update.

subject: Feedback after the trial
body: Thanks for the trial days. Even though it didn't work out, I'd value feedback on what I could improve.

subject: Unacceptable
body: This process is a joke. Your recruiter ghosted me for a month and then sent a template. I'll be telling everyone I know how you treat people.

subject: Portfolio upload
body: I uploaded my portfolio to the portal yesterday. Can you confirm it went through?

subject: Task dates and a religious holiday
body: I observe a religious holiday next week. Could the task window avoid those dates?

subject: Missing dataset
body: The task brief mentions a dataset, but I can't find it anywhere in the materials.

subject: Stepping back
body: After thinking it over, I'd like to step back from the take-home stage. Thank you for your time.

subject: Data request
body: Under data protection law, I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me.

subject: Later slot on the same day?
body: Could I move my call to a later time on the same day? Also, will the call be on video or audio only?
